boundary_evidence: Lower edge 0x020bfec0 is the overlay .text base (the ov006 .text section starts there), so nothing precedes it.
Upper edge 0x020c4048: the next linker unit begins there (tu_map), and its data starts at 0x0213af18, after this unit's last data word 0x0213aee8.
93 functions, contiguous, every one a one-function shard that already byte-matched; no gaps inside 0x020bfec0..0x020c4048.

Data windows are exclusive: all 45 distinct ov006 data targets referenced from the run lie in 0x0213ac48..0x0213aee8, 0x0213ad28, 0x0212b890, 0x0212b89c, 0x0212b8fc, 0x0212c9e4, and none is referenced from outside the run.
bss 0x021402e0..0x021402fc belongs to the one function-local static (guard word, destructor node, Vector3) in FallingPetal_Spawn.
No RTTI, vtable or sinit record separates the run into smaller units, so interior boundaries are unproven and it is folded whole as the tu_map unit.

bss 0x021402e0..0x021402fc: the guard, registration node and storage of FallingPetal_Spawn's function-local static unit-Y Vector3. Only FallingPetal_Spawn refers to the three addresses; the overlay's .bss starts at 0x021402e0, and the next word (0x021402fc) is read by d_mg3d_heyho_obj_adapter.

2026-11-17 (#821): MascotWalker, Dealer, Presenter and FlowerFace hold their state as a real member pointer (StateFn mState, each class's own void (C::*)() type), and the 27 pmf_* records are declared as those types. The StateSlot / VolatileStateSlot views, the per-class state typedefs and the launders around them (volatile word reads, the u64 identity mask, the long long stateRecord pointer, the no-op ternary, the hand-expanded {fn, adj} comparisons) are gone: the setters assign, the dispatches call (this->*mState)(), and the IsIdle, IsIdleAtRest and IsBusy tests return their comparisons directly (the 0/1 flag shapes were not load-bearing either). The records stay extern: they sit in .data between the walker's paths, the dealer's matrices and the presenter's BTA records, whose types are not established. sAxis$691 / _ZGVsAxis$691 / @694 re-keyed to $687 / @690. tubuild verify 93/93 TEXT-VERIFIED (base 93/93); linkcheck SCRATCH-DATA-VERIFIED.

2026-11-17 (#821): the 27 pmf_* externs are gone. Each state assignment and IsIdle / IsIdleAtRest / IsBusy compare names &Class::State, and mwcc emits each use as its own 8-byte {fn, 0} .data literal (@NNN), so the same handler used in two functions is two records (the _2 / _3 names). The unit owns them through five named .data routes: .data.pmf_Dealer 0x0213ac48..0x0213acc0 (dealer and walker), .data.pmf_Presenter 0x0213adb8..0x0213add8, .data.pmf_PresenterWin 0x0213ade0..0x0213ade8, .data.pmf_PresenterMiss 0x0213adf0..0x0213ae00 and .data.pmf_FlowerFace 0x0213aec0..0x0213aee8. Each literal is renamed from its compiler number by object pairing (the consumer relocation in the ROM and the literal's own handler relocation agree) with a LOCAL->GLOBAL binding rewrite. The words between the routes stay ROM bytes: data_ov006_0213add8 / 0213ade8 are the "m_eye_r" / "m_eye_l" strings the .rodata BTA material records at 0x0212b908.. point at, and 0x0213ae00..0x0213aec0 are the eight presenter BTA headers that point into that same unclaimed .rodata. sAxis$687 / _ZGVsAxis$687 / @690 re-keyed to $696 / @699 (paired by section offset, size, type and name).
